name: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold
problems: correlated errors (e.g. from cosmic rays or two-level system defects) remain a limiting factor for reaching error rates needed for commercially relevant applications
source_notes: Google Quantum AI, Nature (9 Dec 2024). First superconducting processor (Willow, 105 qubits) to show exponentially decreasing logical error rates as physical qubits scale up ('below threshold'), using a surface code with real-time decoding.
